title: Greenwich Village and Washington Square Park Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Greenwich Village on a luxury, small-group food tour combining high-end tastings with culture, history, and architecture. Enjoy a mix of seated and on-the-go bites at standout family-owned spots—often with VIP, skip-the-line access—while strolling charming brownstone streets and visiting icons like Washington Square Park and Stonewall National Monument.
